scripts.tokens:check: npm run tokens:generate && git diff --exit-code -- src/shared/ui/theme/generated/
scripts.test:e2e:prepare: npm run test:e2e:seed-fixtures && npm run test:e2e:generate-manifest
scripts.test:visual: npm run test:e2e:prepare && playwright test tests/e2e/visual.spec.ts
scripts.test:visual:components: npm run test:e2e:prepare && playwright test tests/e2e/component-gallery.spec.ts
scripts.test:a11y: npm run test:e2e:prepare && playwright test tests/e2e/a11y.spec.ts
scripts.test:seo: npm run test:e2e:prepare && playwright test tests/e2e/seo.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:update: npm run test:e2e:prepare && playwright test tests/e2e/visual.spec.ts --update-snapshots
scripts.test:e2e:update:components: npm run test:e2e:prepare && playwright test tests/e2e/component-gallery.spec.ts --update-snapshots
scripts.test:e2e:update:og: npm run test:e2e:prepare && playwright test tests/e2e/og-image.spec.ts --update-snapshots
scripts.test:e2e:update:all: npm run test:e2e:prepare && playwright test tests/e2e/visual.spec.ts tests/e2e/component-gallery.spec.ts tests/e2e/og-image.spec.ts --update-snapshots
